armas.d:
A standard dagger with a straight blade.

Though modest in reach and capacity for harm, this weapon is light enough to jab in rapid succession and delivers devastating critical hits.

o.en: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 400 runes.
o.pt: Vendido pelas Twin Maiden Husks na Roundtable Hold por 400 runas.

armas.d:
A knife with curved handguards.
Designed to parry, turning foes' attacks against them.

For masters of combat who anticipate every enemy strike and counter accordingly, this weapon is all they need.

o.en: Sold by Patches (Mt. Gelmir - Minor Erdtree, Seethewater Cave Entrance (Altus Plateau)) for 1,600 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Patches (Mt. Gelmir - Minor Erdtree, Seethewater Cave Entrance (Altus Plateau)) por 1.600 runas.

armas.d:
Dagger favored by military physicians in white.
The pointed blade is hard and sharp, making critical hits especially potent.

Medicine is mercy, and mercy upon the battlefield is ruthless. Beware the killers clothed as men of compassion.

o.en: On a corpse in Stormveil Castle (Limgrave), near the Rampart Tower grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Stormveil Castle (Limgrave), perto da graça Rampart Tower.

armas.d:
Large knife with a broad, curved blade.

This weapon is designed to slash and rend, inflicting blood loss upon the recipient.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Dagger with a bloodstained blade.
Afflicts targets with blood loss.

As blood darkened the dagger through repeated slashing and stabbing, its blade only grew sharper and harder.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
An erdsteel dagger with a grass crest engraved upon its blade. Carried by the Erdtree royalty for self-defense in times of peace.

Though forged to a high standard, the weapon is difficult to wield.
Attack power also scales with faith.

o.en: On a corpse in Leyndell, Royal Capital, near the Lower Capital Church grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Leyndell, Royal Capital, perto da graça Lower Capital Church.

o.en: Dropped by Kenneth Haight, Limgrave Heir in Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Kenneth Haight, Limgrave Heir em Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Short sword with a tempering pattern on the blade.
A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds.
Afflicts targets with blood loss.
These swords are considered auxiliary weapons.
Yet, one man is known to wield this weapon in his left hand while using a full-sized katana in his right. A demonic swordsman known only as Okina.

o.en: On a corpse in Gaol Cave (Caelid).
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Gaol Cave (Caelid).

armas.d:
Sickle decorated with flowers and many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.

Crafted from human bone.
Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Sickle fashioned from ivory.
Weapon carried by aged Albinaurics.

These weapons are evidence of their dedication to the Haligtree, despite never having entered its presence.

o.en: On a corpse in Liurnia of the Lakes - West Albinauric Village, near the Village of the Albinaurics grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Liurnia of the Lakes - West Albinauric Village, perto da graça Village of the Albinaurics.

armas.d:
A knife made by sharpening hard crystal.
Signature weapon of glintstone miners.

Used as tool to extract glintstone from broken rock, and as such a faint magic enwreathes the blade.

o.en: Inside a chest in Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel (Liurnia of the Lakes), near the Nokstella, Eternal City grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel (Liurnia of the Lakes), perto da graça Nokstella, Eternal City.

armas.d:
Dagger fashioned from a great scorpion's tail, glistening with scarlet rot.

A ceremonial tool used by heretics, crafted from the relic of a sealed outer god.

o.en: Inside a chest in Lake of Rot (Siofra River), near the Grand Cloister grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Lake of Rot (Siofra River), perto da graça Grand Cloister.

armas.d:
Short sword given to high ranking clergymen of Farum Azula.
Raises potency of bestial incantations.

The design celebrates a beast's five fingers, symbolic of the intelligence once granted upon their kind.

o.en: Found in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow - Bestial Sanctum (Caelid).
o.pt: Encontrado em Greyoll's Dragonbarrow - Bestial Sanctum (Caelid).

armas.d: Ritual blade once presented to Leyndell by the Academy of Raya Lucaria to celebrate their newfound peace. Though the weapon is embedded with precious glintstones and features Erdtree ornamentation, the undulating blade is symbolic of an ancient ritual.

o.en: Dropped by Sorceress Sellen in Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes), near the Raya Lucaria Grand Library grace. Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Sorceress Sellen em Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes), perto da graça Raya Lucaria Grand Library. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Jagged dagger with a distinctive curved blade.
Used by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood.

This dagger rips the flesh as it enters, inflicting blood loss with sickening efficacy. A proud testament to the success of its vicious design, this weapon is perpetually coated in blood.

o.en: Reward for defeating Bloody Finger Nerijus in Limgrave - Agheel Lake North, Murkwater Cave Entrance.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Bloody Finger Nerijus em Limgrave - Agheel Lake North, Murkwater Cave Entrance.

armas.d:
Dagger given to one who set out on a journey to fulfill her duty long ago. The power of its former owner, the kindling maiden, is still apparent.

The one who walks alongside flame,
Shall one day meet the road of Destined Death.

o.en: Found in Divine Tower of East Altus (Mountaintops of the Giants), near the Forbidden Lands grace.
o.pt: Encontrado em Divine Tower of East Altus (Mountaintops of the Giants), perto da graça Forbidden Lands.

armas.d:
Dagger once belonging to one of the assassins who murdered Godwyn the Golden on the Night of the Black Knives.

A ritual performed on the oddly misshapen blade imbued it with the power of the stolen Rune of Death.

o.en: Reward for defeating Black Knife Assassin in Altus Plateau - Forest-Spanning Greatbridge, St. Trina's Hideaway, Sainted Hero's Grave Entrance.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Black Knife Assassin em Altus Plateau - Forest-Spanning Greatbridge, St. Trina's Hideaway, Sainted Hero's Grave Entrance.

armas.d:
A short straight sword with a short blade.
In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks.

Lightweight amongst straight swords, this weapon is easy to wield, requiring only humble attributes.

o.en: Sold by Nomadic Merchant (Limgrave - Summonwater Village Outskirts) for 600 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Nomadic Merchant (Limgrave - Summonwater Village Outskirts) por 600 runas.

armas.d:
A straight sword with a double-edged blade.

In addition to its reliable standard damage, this weapon also boasts powerful piercing attacks. A superbly balanced armament.

o.en: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 1,000 runes.
o.pt: Vendido pelas Twin Maiden Husks na Roundtable Hold por 1.000 runas.

armas.d:
A straight sword with a wide blade, suited to slashing attacks.

Horizontal swings boast wide attack range, making it easier to connect with foes.

o.en: Sold by Nomadic Merchant (Limgrave - Coastal Cave Entrance) for 1,800 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Nomadic Merchant (Limgrave - Coastal Cave Entrance) por 1.800 runas.

armas.d:
Straight sword with a rather short but wide blade.
Simple to wield, it was known as the sword of the people.

Though the Erdtree styling is still visible, time has not been kind to this sword, now merely a shadow of its former self.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious
design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army.

Though blackened and damaged by years of use,
it appears to have otherwise been kept in a
serviceable condition, despite the soldiers having
long since lost their minds.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Narrow blade carried by wandering nobles.
Made to be easy to wield.

Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Beloved sword of an aged knight whose last quest was long behind him, repurposed into a walking stick. The tip is rather worn.

Though bent of back and without the brawn required even to raise the sword aloft, still he wished to meet his end with weapon in hand.

o.en: On a corpse in Leyndell, Royal Capital, near the West Capital Rampart grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Leyndell, Royal Capital, perto da graça West Capital Rampart.

armas.d:
Talon-swords are affixed to the legs of Stormveil's warhawks, but this one has been repurposed for human use.

The blade is thin and lightweight so as not to obstruct the hawk's mobility.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
A sword with a glintstone in its handguards. Wielded by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus who seek to master Carian sorcery.
Deals magic damage.

Apparently once used as a staff of sorcery, this sword is made of wood.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Straight sword embedded with a blue glintstone.
Weapon of knights sworn to Carian royalty.

These knights' swords could serve as catalysts, letting them wield sorcerous battle skills. Despite numbering fewer than twenty, this power made them a match for even the champions of gold in battle.

o.en: Inside a chest in Liurnia of the Lakes - The Four Belfries, Giant's Caravan Below.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Liurnia of the Lakes - The Four Belfries, Giant's Caravan Below.

armas.d: Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

o.en: On a corpse in Liurnia of the Lakes - Village of the Albinaurics.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Liurnia of the Lakes - Village of the Albinaurics.

armas.d:
Sword fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human.
It festers with scarlet rot.

Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.

o.en: Inside a chest in Miquella's Haligtree - Elphael, near the Elphael Inner Wall grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Miquella's Haligtree - Elphael, perto da graça Elphael Inner Wall.

armas.d:
Sword forged by servants of Miquella of the Haligtree, with a design modeled after those carried by Carian knights. Instead of glintstone however, amber from the Haligtree is embedded in the blade.

A sumptuous piece, yet it has never been offered to any knight—an ill-starred sword with no master.

o.en: Found in Miquella's Haligtree - Elphael, near the Prayer Room grace.
o.pt: Encontrado em Miquella's Haligtree - Elphael, perto da graça Prayer Room.

armas.d:
Slender straight sword patterned after an antique ornament.
Superior swordsmen prefer to wield one in each hand.

After falling from grace, the dregs of the golden lineage sought power and purpose in the past.

o.en: Reward for defeating Grafted Scion in Chapel of Anticipation (Limgrave).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Grafted Scion em Chapel of Anticipation (Limgrave).

armas.d:
A sword made to commemorate the death of Godwyn the Golden, first of the demigods to die.

Infused with the humble prayer of a young boy; "O brother, lord brother, please die a true death."

o.en: On a corpse in Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau), near the Cathedral of the Forsaken grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau), perto da graça Cathedral of the Forsaken.

armas.d:
Silver sword carried by clerics of St. Trina.
Inflicts sleep ailment upon foes.

St. Trina is an enigmatic figure. Some say she is a comely young girl, others are sure he is a boy. The only certainty is that their appearance was as sudden as their disappearance.

o.en: Inside a chest in Caelid - Caelem Ruins, Forsaken Ruins, Minor Erdtree, Minor Erdtree Catacombs Entrance.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Caelid - Caelem Ruins, Forsaken Ruins, Minor Erdtree, Minor Erdtree Catacombs Entrance.

armas.d:
Treasured sword of Eochaid, a lesser, long-vanished domain.
The copper coloration is not to be confused for rust, but is a conduit for its wielder to move it by their will alone.

Swords of Eochaid dance through the skies.

o.en: Found in Gaol Cave (Caelid).
o.pt: Encontrado em Gaol Cave (Caelid).

armas.d: Hidden sword once granted to the Tarnished of the Roundtable by the Two Fingers. A formless cipher comprises its blade, which deals holy damage no shield can repel. Champions would gather at the Roundtable Hold in days long past, when the Two Fingers were masters of oration, their flesh yet full of vigor.

o.en: Found in Leyndell, Royal Capital, near the Fortified Manor, First Floor grace.
o.pt: Encontrado em Leyndell, Royal Capital, perto da graça Fortified Manor, First Floor.

armas.d:
Storied sword and treasure of Caria Manor.
One of the legendary armaments.

Astrologers, who preceded the sorcerers, established themselves in mountaintops that nearly touched the sky, and considered the Fire Giants their neighbors.

o.en: Inside a chest in Liurnia of the Lakes - Caria Manor.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Liurnia of the Lakes - Caria Manor.

armas.d:
A large sword with a straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient.

The hefty blade can be swung into multiple foes
at once thanks to the broad, sweeping attack,
making fending off crowds all the easier.

o.en: Sold by Nomadic Merchant (Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne Rampart, Ailing Village Outskirts) for 3,000 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Nomadic Merchant (Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne Rampart, Ailing Village Outskirts) por 3.000 runas.

armas.d:
A large sword with a long, straight blade. This heavy sword is usually wielded with two hands, but for those with enough strength, one is sufficient.

In addition to the heavy sweeping attacks, it can also make a heavy piercing thrust, making this a versatile weapon.

o.en: Inside a chest in Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne, near the Behind the Castle grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne, perto da graça Behind the Castle.

armas.d:
Greatsword with a blade of unusually thick steel.
A coarse weapon to which polishing is a foreign concept.

Weighty even among others of its class, the impact of each strike is sure to be felt.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Well-crafted straight sword with an illustrious
design, wielded by regulars of a lord's army.

Though blackened and damaged by years of use, it appears to have otherwise been kept in a serviceable condition, despite the soldiers having long since lost their minds.

o.en: Inside a chest in Limgrave - Gatefront, Stormhill Evergaol, Groveside Cave Entrance, Limgrave Tunnels Entrance.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Limgrave - Gatefront, Stormhill Evergaol, Groveside Cave Entrance, Limgrave Tunnels Entrance.

armas.d:
Greatsword bestowed upon skilled swordsmen in the demigods' service, and yet had no rank or title.

Featuring a long grip enabling dual-handed use, this weapon was designed to dispatch larger foes. Being charged with such a duty was undoubtedly a great honor.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
A finely-crafted greatsword intricately engraved with an ancient motif.
Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.
Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Oddly shaped greatsword wielded by imps.

The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Greatsword featuring a flame-like undulation.
Shreds enemy flesh, inducing blood loss.

Scarlet rot is kept at bay with flame at Redmane Castle, and as such, this beloved sword of Jerren's eventually became the symbol of the castle itself.

o.en: On a corpse in Caelid - Redmane Castle, near the Chamber Outside the Plaza grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Caelid - Redmane Castle, perto da graça Chamber Outside the Plaza.

armas.d:
Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyles.

Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

o.en: Reward for defeating Valiant Gargoyle in Nokron (Siofra River).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Valiant Gargoyle em Nokron (Siofra River).

armas.d:
Bronze greatsword wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax.
Deals holy damage.

Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

o.en: Reward for defeating Black Blade Kindred in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow - Bestial Sanctum (Caelid).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Black Blade Kindred em Greyoll's Dragonbarrow - Bestial Sanctum (Caelid).

armas.d:
Sword forged by compounding silver and gold.
A sacred weapon to hunt Those Who Live in Death.
Deals holy damage.

The inseparable twins found solace in the Golden Order, the only institution not to revile them as accursed beings.

o.en: Found in Deeproot Depths (Siofra River). Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Deeproot Depths (Siofra River). Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Dropped by D, Beholder of Death in several places.
o.pt: Deixado por D, Beholder of Death em vários lugares.

armas.d:
Sinister greatsword fashioned from a giant's backbone.
Metes out wounds like a lopsided saw-blade, and restores some FP upon defeating an enemy.

Milos was undersized for a giant, and was viewed as sullied and terribly grotesque.

o.en: Found in Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital). Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital). Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Reward for defeating Dung Eater in Capital Outskirts - Capital Rampart, Auriza Side Tomb Entrance (Altus Plateau). Can be missed.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Dung Eater em Capital Outskirts - Capital Rampart, Auriza Side Tomb Entrance (Altus Plateau). Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Dropped by Dung Eater in Liurnia of the Lakes - Ranni's Rise, Seluvis's Rise. Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Dung Eater em Liurnia of the Lakes - Ranni's Rise, Seluvis's Rise. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Storied sword of House Marais, the family of executioners who presided over the Shaded Castle.
One of the legendary armaments.

Elemer of the Briar, the Bell Bearing Hunter, snatched the sword from the site of his looming execution, and furnished it with battle skills from his home of Eochaid.

o.en: Reward for defeating Elemer of the Briar in Altus Plateau - Shaded Castle.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Elemer of the Briar em Altus Plateau - Shaded Castle.

armas.d:
Greatsword of Ordovis, one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights.

This sword is imbued with an ancient holy essence.
Its red tint exemplifies the nature of primordial gold, said to be close in nature to life itself.

o.en: Reward for defeating Crucible Knight Ordovis in Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Crucible Knight Ordovis em Auriza Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau).

armas.d:
Greatsword forged from a blue-white meteoric ore.
The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic.

A weapon unique to the Alabaster Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.

o.en: Dropped by Onyx Lord in several places.
o.pt: Deixado por Onyx Lord em vários lugares.

armas.d:
Barbed rod carried by Deathbirds.

The birds are graveyard fire keepers; it is said they rake out the ashen remains of the dead from their kilns.

o.en: Reward for defeating Death Rite Bird in Caelid - Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank. Only at night.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Death Rite Bird em Caelid - Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank. Só à noite.

armas.d:
Greatsword patterned after the black steeple of the Helphen, the lampwood which guides the dead of the spirit world.

The lamplight is similar to grace in appearance, only it is said that it can only be seen by those who met their death in battle.

o.en: Reward for defeating Tibia Mariner in Mountaintops of the Giants - South Castle Sol, Snow Valley Ruins Overlook.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Tibia Mariner em Mountaintops of the Giants - South Castle Sol, Snow Valley Ruins Overlook.

armas.d:
Sacred sword of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.
Remains of the countless heroes he has devoured writhe upon the surface of this blade.

Now they share the same blood, bound together as family.
Some HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.

o.en: Exchanged with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for the Remembrance of the Blasphemous. Can be missed.
o.pt: Trocado com Finger Reader Enia na Roundtable Hold pela Remembrance of the Blasphemous. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Greatsword made of light, modeled after the Elden Ring itself. Forged by King Consort Radagon to proudly
symbolize the tenets of the Golden Order.
One of the legendary armaments.

Telltale signs betray that this was once the greatsword bequeathed to him by his first wife, Rennala.

o.en: Reward for defeating Misbegotten Crusader in Cave of the Forlorn (Mountaintops of the Giants).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Misbegotten Crusader em Cave of the Forlorn (Mountaintops of the Giants).

armas.d:
A Moon Greatsword, bestowed by a Carian queen upon her spouse to honor long-standing tradition.
One of the legendary armaments.

Ranni's sigil is a full moon, cold and leaden, and this sword is but a beam of its light.

o.en: Found in Moonlight Altar - Cathedral of Manus Celes (Liurnia of the Lakes). Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Moonlight Altar - Cathedral of Manus Celes (Liurnia of the Lakes). Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Sword wrought from the remains of a god who should have lived a life eternal.

Thoughts on what the weapon portends are many and varied. Some consider it the mark of a great sin, or a sign of great devastation. Some think it as the end of an age, while others; the beginning.

o.en: Exchanged with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for the Elden Remembrance and 20,000 runes. Can be missed.
o.pt: Trocado com Finger Reader Enia na Roundtable Hold pela Elden Remembrance e 20.000 runas. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Just about the largest sword a mere man is capable of swinging.
True to its name, it is designed to be wielded in both hands, but those of merely ordinary strength will still struggle to do so.

The long blade is heavy and sharp, sending foes reeling back with its broader strokes, while also capable of a devastating piercing thrust.

o.en: Sold by Isolated Merchant (Weeping Peninsula - Isolated Merchant's Shack) for 3,500 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Isolated Merchant (Weeping Peninsula - Isolated Merchant's Shack) por 3.500 runas.

armas.d:
A coarse iron lump of an ultra greatsword.
Mows down foes by utilizing its incredible weight.

Though handling it likely requires the wielder to have surpassed the realm of the merely human, it is precisely for this reason the weapon is used to slaughter even inhuman foes.

o.en: Inside a chest in Caelid - Caelem Ruins, Forsaken Ruins, Minor Erdtree, Minor Erdtree Catacombs Entrance.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Caelid - Caelem Ruins, Forsaken Ruins, Minor Erdtree, Minor Erdtree Catacombs Entrance.

armas.d:
Stone greatsword wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs.

Though decorated with the watchman's eye, the pupil was taken by graverobbers and is now hollow, leaving this sword a mere lump of stone.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Sword given to the lesser giants who fought for the Erdtree during the War against the Giants long ago.

Though they have lost their minds, they stay inseparable from their swords that are in sad shape—such that the gold plating had flaked away.

o.en: Inside a chest in Altus Plateau - Altus Highway Junction, near the Erdtree-Gazing Hill grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Altus Plateau - Altus Highway Junction, perto da graça Erdtree-Gazing Hill.

armas.d:
Greatsword embedded with a blue glintstone.
Weapon of the trolls in service to the royal family of Caria. Called into service when the Queen invoked an oath they swore, the trolls are treated as true knights of Caria, and fight arm in arm with their human comrades.

o.en: Dropped by Troll Knight in Liurnia of the Lakes - Caria Manor, near the Royal Moongazing Grounds grace.
o.pt: Deixado por Troll Knight em Liurnia of the Lakes - Caria Manor, perto da graça Royal Moongazing Grounds.

armas.d:
Greatsword decorated in royal Carian style.
Favored weapon of Blaidd the Half-Wolf.

In defiance of the fate he was born to, Blaidd swore to serve no master but Ranni. As proof, the sword was imbued with a cold magic at the moment the oath was sworn.

o.en: Dropped by Blaidd the Half-Wolf in Liurnia of the Lakes - Ranni's Rise, Seluvis's Rise, near the Ranni's Chamber grace. Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Blaidd the Half-Wolf em Liurnia of the Lakes - Ranni's Rise, Seluvis's Rise, perto da graça Ranni's Chamber. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
The storied sword of Castle Morne. A revenger's weapon, it is burdened with oceans of anger and regret.
One of the legendary armaments.

A lone surviving champion from a country now vanished was so determined to continue fighting that he claimed the swords of an entire clan of warriors.

o.en: Reward for defeating Leonine Misbegotten in Weeping Peninsula - Morne Moangrave.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Leonine Misbegotten em Weeping Peninsula - Morne Moangrave.

armas.d:
Originally rubble from a ruin which fell from the sky, this surviving fragment was honed into a weapon.
One of the legendary armaments.

The ruin it came from crumbled when struck by a meteorite, as such this weapon harbors its destructive power.

o.en: Reward for defeating Crucible Knight in Caelid - Redmane Castle.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Crucible Knight em Caelid - Redmane Castle.

armas.d:
Curved greatswords of black steel wielded by General Radahn.
A pair of weapons decorated with a lion mane motif.

Radahn earned considerable renown as the Starscourge in his youth, and it is said that it was during this time he engraved the gravity crest upon these blades.

o.en: Exchanged with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for the Remembrance of the Starscourge. Can be missed.
o.pt: Trocado com Finger Reader Enia na Roundtable Hold pela Remembrance of the Starscourge. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Sacred sword of the Gloam-Eyed Queen who controlled the Godskin Apostles before her defeat at the hands of Maliketh.

The black flames wielded by the apostles are channeled from this sword.

o.en: Inside a chest in Divine Tower of Caelid (Greyoll's Dragonbarrow), near the Divine Tower of Caelid: Basement grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Divine Tower of Caelid (Greyoll's Dragonbarrow), perto da graça Divine Tower of Caelid: Basement.

armas.d:
Maliketh's black blade which once harbored the power of the Rune of Death. A sad shadow of its former glory.

After a fragment of Death was stolen on that fateful night, Maliketh bound the blade within his own flesh, such that none might ever rob Death again.

o.en: Exchanged with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for the Remembrance of the Black Blade. Can be missed.
o.pt: Trocado com Finger Reader Enia na Roundtable Hold pela Remembrance of the Black Blade. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
A piercing sword with a sharp, slender blade.
In addition to this weapon's thrusting attack prowess, it also boasts the ability to be used while guarding with a shield.

As one of the smaller piercing swords, quick successive thrusts are easy to perform, but without a cutting edge, it cannot be used for slashing attacks.

o.en: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 1,000 runes.
o.pt: Vendido pelas Twin Maiden Husks na Roundtable Hold por 1.000 runas.

armas.d:
Large piercing sword with a long, hard bladed edge which is also capable of slashing attacks.

For its large size, it can be wielded rather nimbly, leaving little opportunity for the enemy to counter.

o.en: Sold by Patches (Mt. Gelmir - Minor Erdtree, Seethewater Cave Entrance (Altus Plateau)) for 3,000 runes. Can be missed.
o.pt: Vendido por Patches (Mt. Gelmir - Minor Erdtree, Seethewater Cave Entrance (Altus Plateau)) por 3.000 runas. Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Sold by Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia of the Lakes - Laskyar Ruins, Malefactor's Evergaol) for 3,000 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia of the Lakes - Laskyar Ruins, Malefactor's Evergaol) por 3.000 runas.

armas.d:
Estoc carried by wandering nobles.
Made to be easy to wield.

Daubed with gold from tip to tail, it should fetch a good sum.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Piercing sword of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

Mainly used as a backup weapon, in combination with a long-handled armament.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Piercing sword of superior quality, featuring intricate ornamentation.
Signature weapon of the sorcerer Rogier.

High dexterity is required to wield the blade to its full potential, but mastery is a sight to behold, characterized by a flowing style which excels in successive attacks.

o.en: Found in Roundtable Hold (Limgrave). Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Roundtable Hold (Limgrave). Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Dropped by Sorcerer Rogier in Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Sorcerer Rogier em Stormveil Castle (Limgrave). Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Spur of a giant ant which has been fashioned into a rapier. The blade drips with scarlet rot.

Scarlet rot is an old legend, of which Maleigh Marais of the Shaded Castle was a private believer. And indeed, he eventually found his own personal goddess.

o.en: Reward for defeating Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan in Mt. Gelmir - First Mt. Gelmir Campsite, Corpse-Stench Shack; Altus Plateau - West of Shaded Castle.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Maleigh Marais, Shaded Castle Castellan em Mt. Gelmir - First Mt. Gelmir Campsite, Corpse-Stench Shack; Altus Plateau - West of Shaded Castle.

armas.d:
A razor-thin piercing blade of ice.
Forged by Iji, the Carian Royal Blacksmith.

Can inflict frost upon enemies, and launch its blade with a strong attack. The blade immediately regenerates.

o.en: Inside a chest in Liurnia of the Lakes - Northern Liurnia Lake Shore, Kingsrealm Ruins.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Liurnia of the Lakes - Northern Liurnia Lake Shore, Kingsrealm Ruins.

armas.d:
Large rapier featuring a thin, sharp blade.
Commonly used in life or death duels.

Like its smaller counterparts, it is made for thrusting attacks, and can be used while guarding with a shield.

o.en: Inside a chest in Limgrave - Agheel Lake South, Forlorn Hound Evergaol.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Limgrave - Agheel Lake South, Forlorn Hound Evergaol.

armas.d:
Elegant piercing sword with a celadon colored blade wielded by Godskin Nobles.

The nobles possess skill with the sword unmatched by any lowborn. Despite its size, successive attacks from this weapon are swifter than the eye can follow.

o.en: Reward for defeating Godskin Noble in Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Godskin Noble em Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau).

armas.d:
Ominous piercing sword with a winding blade.
Carried by the noble servants of the Lord of Blood.

Designed to bore into flesh, causing severe blood loss at the wound. The extracted blood trickles gracefully down the length of the blade.

o.en: Inside a chest in Altus Plateau - Bower of Bounty, Writheblood Ruins.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Altus Plateau - Bower of Bounty, Writheblood Ruins.

armas.d:
Piercing Gravel Stone sword containing primeval lightning.
A portion of the Dragonlord's power, gained from a remembrance.

This weapon commands great power over the paltry, mortal dragons of today.

o.en: Exchanged with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for the Remembrance of the Dragonlord and 20,000 runes. Can be missed.
o.pt: Trocado com Finger Reader Enia na Roundtable Hold pela Remembrance of the Dragonlord e 20.000 runas. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
A curved sword with a single-sided blade.
Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against thick armor and hides covered in tough scales.

Smaller in size than most curved swords, it carves into enemies with quick, sharp cuts.

o.en: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 600 runes.
o.pt: Vendido pelas Twin Maiden Husks na Roundtable Hold por 600 runas.

armas.d:
A curved sword with a single-sided blade.
Delivers slashing attacks with its sharp blade, but is ineffective against thick armor and hides covered in tough scales.

Wielders of the weapon employ a unique style that enhances attacks with spinning motions.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Curved sword with a thin blade of ample length.
Light of weight despite its larger size, its slicing attacks come in rapid succession.

A devastatingly powerful weapon in the hands of a skilled swordsman.

o.en: On a corpse in Highroad Cave (Limgrave).
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Highroad Cave (Limgrave).

armas.d:
Curved sword boasting a large blade.
This weapon is designed to make use of its weight in combination with its sharp cutting edge.

A thoroughly reliable choice of weapon for those who can master its particulars.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Curved sword with a light, crescent-shaped blade.
Used by the bandits who ran rampant in the wake of the Shattering.

Most of the blade is now darkened and covered in rust, but with enough dexterity this weapon may still stand up to some use.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Curved sword with a severely hooked blade. Its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.

Made to hunt down humans, this weapon requires high dexterity to wield effectively.

o.en: Sold by Abandoned Merchant (Siofra River) for 2,500 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Abandoned Merchant (Siofra River) por 2.500 runas.

armas.d:
Unique curved sword, notched like shark's teeth.
Weapon carried by corpse pillagers who prowl the sites of old battles.

The blade is tacky with blood and covered in hefty nicks, making it totally uneven. Life can be sinister indeed.

o.en: On a corpse in Mt. Gelmir - Minor Erdtree, Seethewater Cave Entrance (Altus Plateau), near Corpse-Stench Shack.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Mt. Gelmir - Minor Erdtree, Seethewater Cave Entrance (Altus Plateau), perto de Corpse-Stench Shack.

armas.d:
A curved sword with a blade at both ends wielded by the Cemetery Shades, the insect-ridden grave keepers.

The blade is thin and sharp, and strong attack unleashes a far-reaching slash.

o.en: Dropped by Cemetery Shade in Gelmir Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau), near the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber grace.
o.pt: Deixado por Cemetery Shade em Gelmir Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau), perto da graça Subterranean Inquisition Chamber.

armas.d:
Curved sword forged of dull iron wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula.

The blade is heavy but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Legends speak of a master of the sword garbed in blue, and his curved blade that was patterned after flowing water.

Strong attack unleashes a series of strikes akin to a dance, offering a glimpse into the legend.

o.en: Inside a chest in Consecrated Snowfield - Northwest Foggy Area, East of Yelough Anix Ruins (Mountaintops of the Giants), near the Inner Consecrated Snowfield grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Consecrated Snowfield - Northwest Foggy Area, East of Yelough Anix Ruins (Mountaintops of the Giants), perto da graça Inner Consecrated Snowfield.

armas.d:
Curved sword fashioned in the image of an ancient serpent deity and tool of a forgotten religion practiced on Mt. Gelmir.

Formerly used to offer up sacrifices, this sword restores HP upon slaying an enemy.

o.en: On a corpse in Ruin-Strewn Precipice (Liurnia of the Lakes).
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Ruin-Strewn Precipice (Liurnia of the Lakes).

armas.d:
Curved sword with a blade fashioned from the lava of Mt. Gelmir.
An armament of the man-serpents, impossible for a human to have made.

Deals fire damage.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
A grim weapon wielded by swordsmen of the Eternal City, this shotel has a blade as fine as a needle.

Forged from the liquid metal of a Silver Tear, it is thoroughly tempered until hardened.

o.en: Reward for defeating Nox Monk in Caelid - West Sellia, Sellia Crystal Tunnel Entrance.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Nox Monk em Caelid - West Sellia, Sellia Crystal Tunnel Entrance.

armas.d:
Sword fashioned from a delicate wing, suffused with the magic of the stars.
Strong attack unleashes a wave of enchanted light.

Crafted from a relic of the Naturalborn of the Void who is said to have assailed the Eternal City.

o.en: Inside a chest in Ainsel River (Siofra River), near the Ainsel River Downstream grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Ainsel River (Siofra River), perto da graça Ainsel River Downstream.

armas.d:
Storied sword and treasure of Castle Sol that depicts an eclipsed sun drained of color.
One of the legendary armaments.

In Sol, the sight of an eclipse inspires a dreadful awe, preventing an onlooker from averting his gaze.

o.en: On a corpse in Mountaintops of the Giants - South Castle Sol, Snow Valley Ruins Overlook, near the Church of the Eclipse grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Mountaintops of the Giants - South Castle Sol, Snow Valley Ruins Overlook, perto da graça Church of the Eclipse.

armas.d:
This curved greatsword wielded by the brawny sellswords of Kaiden combines the blade of a scimitar with the heft of a hatchet.

A difficult to handle weapon that demands much of the wielder's strength and dexterity, but with practice and ability, it can serve as a versatile weapon even on horseback.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Heavy-bladed curved sword of colossal size awarded to Omen as a tool of war. This weapon is made to take advantage of brute strength.

The pattern etched upon the blade is the remnant of a deteriorative malediction. Indeed, when bestowing a weapon, preparations must be made for taking it away.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Curved sword with a flickering flame motif.
Wielded by the Fire Monks who came from the Mountaintops of the Giants.

The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Curved greatsword of colossal size forged of dull iron and wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula.

The blade is incredibly heavy, but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers. It's clear the beastmen possess knowledge beyond human ken.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Curved greatsword with a gently undulating blade wielded by Bloodhound Knights.

A fearsome blade capable of brutal airborne attacks.

o.en: Reward for defeating Bloodhound Knight Darriwil in Limgrave - Agheel Lake South, Forlorn Hound Evergaol.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Bloodhound Knight Darriwil em Limgrave - Agheel Lake South, Forlorn Hound Evergaol.

armas.d:
Greatsword forged from golden-hued meteoric ore.
The blade conceals gravity-manipulating magic.

A weapon unique to the Onyx Lords, a race of ancients with skin of stone who were said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago.

o.en: Reward for defeating Onyx Lord in Divine Tower of West Altus (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Onyx Lord em Divine Tower of West Altus (Altus Plateau).

armas.d:
Weapon wielded by the knights of Zamor who earned great renown during the War against the Giants.

In apparent devotion to winter, the curved blade is styled after an icy wind and imbued with a powerful frost effect.

o.en: Reward for defeating Ancient Hero of Zamor in Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Ancient Hero of Zamor em Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants).

armas.d:
Curved greatsword wielded by Magma Wyrms. The shape resembles a dragon's jaw and is covered in hard scales.

It's said these land-bound dragons were once human heroes who partook in dragon communion, a grave transgression for which they were cursed to crawl the earth upon their bellies, shadows of their former selves.

o.en: Reward for defeating Magma Wyrm Makar in Ruin-Strewn Precipice (Liurnia of the Lakes).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Magma Wyrm Makar em Ruin-Strewn Precipice (Liurnia of the Lakes).

armas.d:
Warped blade of shifting hue used by Morgott, the Omen King.

The accursed blood that Morgott recanted and sealed away reformed into this blade.

o.en: Exchanged with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for the Remembrance of the Omen King. Can be missed.
o.pt: Trocado com Finger Reader Enia na Roundtable Hold pela Remembrance of the Omen King. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
A katana with a long single-edged curved blade.
A unique weapon wielded by the samurai from the Land of Reeds.

The blade, with its undulating design, boasts extraordinary sharpness, and its slash attacks cause blood loss.

o.en: On a corpse in Deathtouched Catacombs (Limgrave).
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Deathtouched Catacombs (Limgrave).

armas.d:
Katana with a ferociously long blade.
Signature weapon of Yura, hunter of Bloody Fingers.

Reminiscent of a reinforced spear, its imposing length can be put to good use with powerful thrusting attacks.

o.en: Found in Altus Plateau - Second Church of Marika. Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Altus Plateau - Second Church of Marika. Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Dropped by Yura, Hunter of Bloody Fingers in Limgrave - Seaside Ruins. Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Yura, Hunter of Bloody Fingers em Limgrave - Seaside Ruins. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Sinister katana modeled after a serpent bone.

The densely packed row of spines that jut away from the cutting edge are coated in a lethal poison.

o.en: Dropped by Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress in Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau). Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress em Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau). Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Katana forged from meteoric ore to dispatch lifeforms born of falling stars.
Deals magic damage.

The blade is weighty, known to deliver slashes of such ferocity that the impact is said to resemble the crash of a falling meteor.

o.en: Inside a chest in Caelid - Fort Gael, Caelid Waypoint Ruins, Gaol Cave Entrance.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Caelid - Fort Gael, Caelid Waypoint Ruins, Gaol Cave Entrance.

armas.d:
Katana forged of glintstone.
Masterpiece of a Sellian swordsmith.

Light enwreathes the blade when sheathed, explaining its Moonveil moniker.

o.en: Reward for defeating Magma Wyrm in Gael Tunnel (Caelid).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Magma Wyrm em Gael Tunnel (Caelid).

armas.d:
Weapon of Okina, swordsman from the Land of Reeds.
A cursed weapon that has felled countless men.

When Mohg, the Lord of Blood, first felt Okina's sword, and madness, upon his flesh, he had a proposal, to offer Okina the life of a demon, whose thirst would never go unsated.

o.en: Reward for defeating Bloody Finger Okina in Flame Peak - Southwest Giants' Gravepost (Mountaintops of the Giants).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Bloody Finger Okina em Flame Peak - Southwest Giants' Gravepost (Mountaintops of the Giants).

armas.d:
A weapon made by sharpening a Gravel Stone scale, thought to be the source of ancient dragon immortality, into an unclouded blade.

Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.

o.en: Reward for defeating Dragonkin Soldier in Lake of Rot (Siofra River).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Dragonkin Soldier em Lake of Rot (Siofra River).

armas.d:
Blade built into Malenia's prosthetic arm.
Through consecration it is resistant to rot.

Malenia's war prosthesis symbolized her victories.
Some claim to have seen wings when the weapon was raised aloft; wings of fierce determination that have never known defeat.

o.en: Exchanged with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for the Remembrance of the Rot Goddess. Can be missed.
o.pt: Trocado com Finger Reader Enia na Roundtable Hold pela Remembrance of the Rot Goddess. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
A sword with blades on both sides of the hilt.
This weapon is difficult to wield and demands high dexterity.

Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.

o.en: Inside a chest in Limgrave - Agheel Lake, Dragon-Burnt Ruins.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Limgrave - Agheel Lake, Dragon-Burnt Ruins.

armas.d:
An attractive twinblade of fine make that prizes the chivalric way.

Can be wielded with a single hand, but its true strength is unlocked with dual-handed spinning attacks.

o.en: On a corpse in Altus Plateau - Village Windmill Pasture, East Windmill Pasture.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Altus Plateau - Village Windmill Pasture, East Windmill Pasture.

armas.d:
Unique twinblade wielded by Godskin Apostles characterized by its disturbing design. One end features a sickle for slicing attacks while the other boasts a winding spike for boring into flesh.

Much skill is required to wield this weapon due to its asymmetric nature.

o.en: Reward for defeating Godskin Apostle in Altus Plateau - Windmill Heights.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Godskin Apostle em Altus Plateau - Windmill Heights.

armas.d:
Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyles.

Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

o.en: Reward for defeating Valiant Gargoyle in Nokron (Siofra River).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Valiant Gargoyle em Nokron (Siofra River).

armas.d:
Bronze twinblade wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax.
Deals holy damage.

Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

o.en: Reward for defeating Black Blade Kindred in Mountaintops of the Giants - Before Grand Lift of Rold.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Black Blade Kindred em Mountaintops of the Giants - Before Grand Lift of Rold.

armas.d:
Twinned naginata forged in the Land of Reeds.
Chosen weapon of Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger.

Her mastery of the sword was such that her onslaught was likened to a whirlwind, but now her legacy is stained by accursed blood.

o.en: Reward for defeating Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger in Altus Plateau - Second Church of Marika.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger em Altus Plateau - Second Church of Marika.

armas.d:
Commonly known as a hatchet, this smaller variety of axe is an everyday work tool.

Despite its short reach, it is easy to handle, exceling in successive attacks.

o.en: Sold by Nomadic Merchant (Limgrave - Fort Haight West (Meteored)) for 600 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Nomadic Merchant (Limgrave - Fort Haight West (Meteored)) por 600 runas.

armas.d:
Peculiar hatchet wielded by imps.

The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
A thick, heavy blade attached to a handle. A versatile, standard weapon

Capable of powerful attacks thanks to the weighty blade, these weapons are also regarded for their powerful charge attacks.

o.en: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 800 runes.
o.pt: Vendido pelas Twin Maiden Husks na Roundtable Hold por 800 runas.

armas.d:
Oversized double-headed axe with a bizarre, almost melted appearance.

Brute strength is the only thing required to wield this weapon, which appears to have taken quite the beating itself.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Axe made from a herbivore's skull. Weapon of the ancestral followers who disdain metal.

This axe is more of a bludgeon; it forgoes a bladed edge, instead using the beast's molar teeth to buffet foes, dealing strike damage.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Fairly large iron cleaver, commonly used by the maltreated Misbegotten.

Steeped in resentment, these weapons are swung wildly and relentlessly, often after rushing up to foes.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Single-sided axe used by the warriors of the highlands.

Brave combatants begin battle by crying out their names. Roars are enhanced by this weapon.

o.en: On a corpse in Stormveil Castle (Limgrave), near the Rampart Tower grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Stormveil Castle (Limgrave), perto da graça Rampart Tower.

armas.d:
Cleaver decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.

Crafted from human bone.
Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Hatchet used in ancient sacrificial rite. A Deathbird is depicted as a malevolent deity.

The power of the rite yet lingers. A small amount of FP is restored upon slaying a foe.

o.en: Reward for defeating Deathbird in Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne Approach North. Only at night.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Deathbird em Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne Approach North. Só à noite.

armas.d:
A hatchet with a frost-coated blade. One of several gifts given by Castle Sol in the distant north.

Known as "freezing fog," the blade is thought to be a dragon's scale. Inflicts a powerful frost effect.

o.en: Inside a chest in Liurnia of the Lakes - Temple Quarter.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Liurnia of the Lakes - Temple Quarter.

armas.d:
Unique weapon wielded by young Albinaurics, this sword is modelled after the ripples that are thought to be the origin of their species.

Its attack power is greatly enhanced with one's arcane attribute.

o.en: Sold by Pidia, Carian Servant (Liurnia of the Lakes - Caria Manor) for 3,500 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Pidia, Carian Servant (Liurnia of the Lakes - Caria Manor) por 3.500 runas.

armas.d:
Battle axe designed to resemble a hawk, with its wings comprising the blade. Signature weapon of warriors who strive to remain one with the storm, despite being so far from their place of birth.

Their hearts are proud, and thereby easily undone.

o.en: On a corpse in Leyndell, Royal Capital, near the Fortified Manor, First Floor grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Leyndell, Royal Capital, perto da graça Fortified Manor, First Floor.

o.en: On a corpse in Mountaintops of the Giants - South Castle Sol, Snow Valley Ruins Overlook, near the Church of the Eclipse grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Mountaintops of the Giants - South Castle Sol, Snow Valley Ruins Overlook, perto da graça Church of the Eclipse.

o.en: Dropped by Nepheli Loux, Warrior in several places.
o.pt: Deixado por Nepheli Loux, Warrior em vários lugares.

armas.d:
Usher of Death, Rosus, who shows the path to the catacombs throughout the Lands Between, is depicted on this ritual axe.

The dead easily lose their way, and have always been in sore need of a guiding hand.

o.en: On a corpse in Black Knife Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes).
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Black Knife Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes).

armas.d:
Greataxe akin to a huge lump of iron. Recognized as the weapon of choice of badland chieftains.

Too heavy to be wielded by those of merely ordinary strength, blows from this axe will flatten enemies, and the force of its charged attack is a sight to behold.

o.en: Inside a chest in Limgrave - Waypoint Ruins, near the Waypoint Ruins Cellar grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Limgrave - Waypoint Ruins, perto da graça Waypoint Ruins Cellar.

armas.d:
Greataxe with a large, arcing blade and long handle. The "Crescent Moon" of its name is said to have been spurred by nostalgia.

Specializes in sweeping through foes by making use of its long handle.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Large iron axe with a long handle. Weapon of the maltreated Misbegotten.

Making use of the force generated by its length, this weapon's resentment-charged blows are difficult to stop.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Bulky cleaver welded to a long haft. Said to have been used to dispatch the remnants of defeated armies, felling them like timber.

Perhaps that is the reason it excels at critical hits.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
The blade of this huge, loathsome cleaver comprises a row of amputated Omen horns. Weapon of slaughter wielded by Omenkillers.

The hideous horns cause blood loss, adding vibrant colors to the ongoing mayhem.

o.en: Reward for defeating Miranda the Blighted Bloom in Perfumer's Grotto (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Miranda the Blighted Bloom em Perfumer's Grotto (Altus Plateau).

o.en: Dropped by Omenkiller in several places.
o.pt: Deixado por Omenkiller em vários lugares.

armas.d:
A rusty anchor wielded as a weapon. Each of its four flukes is thick and sharp, enabling piercing attacks.

When the Tarnished left the Lands Between with their Lord, one boat alone was said to have been left behind.

o.en: Reward for defeating Scaly Misbegotten in Morne Tunnel (Weeping Peninsula).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Scaly Misbegotten em Morne Tunnel (Weeping Peninsula).

armas.d:
Huge carving knife made to cleanly butcher the human body. Signature weapon of the Ogress Anastasia, known to have eaten countless Tarnished while disguised as a Finger Maiden.

Restores a very small amount of HP when it squarely strikes an enemy.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyles.

Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

o.en: Reward for defeating Gargoyle in Capital Outskirts - Outer Wall Phantom Tree (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Gargoyle em Capital Outskirts - Outer Wall Phantom Tree (Altus Plateau).

armas.d:
Bronze greataxe wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax.
Deals holy damage.

Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

o.en: Reward for defeating Black Blade Kindred in Mountaintops of the Giants - Before Grand Lift of Rold.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Black Blade Kindred em Mountaintops of the Giants - Before Grand Lift of Rold.

armas.d:
Distinctive horn suffused with the power of ancestral spirits. This large, wing-shaped specimen is wielded as a weapon of spirit worship.

In the ancestral spirit-worshipping faith, these are considered envoys' wings, made to reap the lives of beings which experience no sprouting.

o.en: Exchanged with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for the Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor and 3,000 runes. Can be missed.
o.pt: Trocado com Finger Reader Enia na Roundtable Hold pela Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor e 3.000 runas. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Greataxe wielded by Godrick the Grafted. This golden battleaxe is emblazoned with the figure of a beast, representing the strength of Godfrey, First Elden Lord and patriarch of the golden lineage.

"I command thee kneel! For I am the lord of all that is golden!"

o.en: Exchanged with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for the Remembrance of the Grafted. Can be missed.
o.pt: Trocado com Finger Reader Enia na Roundtable Hold pela Remembrance of the Grafted. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
A thick, solid lump of wood.
Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill.

A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength and persistence to hammer your foe into the ground.

o.en: Sold by Nomadic Merchant (Limgrave - Coastal Cave Entrance) for 600 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Nomadic Merchant (Limgrave - Coastal Cave Entrance) por 600 runas.

armas.d:
Hard, curved club, shaped like a crescent moon.

Wielded instead of a curved sword by Albinaurics lacking dexterity. The only point of similarity between the two is the shape.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
A club with beast fangs wrapped around the striking end. The uneven spread of fangs causes blood loss.

Given only to the toughest of demi-humans, this weapon is a badge of honor. Or so the demi-humans believe.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Signature weapon of battlemages, hewn from hard glintstone. This club is much heavier than its size suggests, but has no magic power.

So that they not lose sight of the true essence of combat, battlemages prefer to feel the impact of their blows, fighting their opponents hand to hand.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
An iron bludgeon with sharp protrusions.

Striking attacks have few drawbacks, potent as they are at breaking through guards and stances. Most suited to head on slugging matches.

o.en: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 800 runes.
o.pt: Vendido pelas Twin Maiden Husks na Roundtable Hold por 800 runas.

armas.d:
Battle hammer comprised of a globe attached to a handle. Though a bludgeon dealing strike damage, the appellative star is covered in spikes which cause blood loss.

Ironic given its graceful name, this weapon often reeks of blood.

o.en: Inside a chest in Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne Rampart, Ailing Village Outskirts, near the South of the Lookout Tower grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne Rampart, Ailing Village Outskirts, perto da graça South of the Lookout Tower.

armas.d:
Battle hammer with a hard protruding beak.
A pickaxe designed for combat, in essence.

A simple but highly effective weapon, the weighty piercing attack casually rips through metal armor.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Hammer comprised of a large stone affixed to a metal handle. Originally a blacksmith's tool.

The art of smithing is said to have originated among the giants. This weapon's striking attacks boast ample weight behind them.

o.en: Found in Leyndell, Royal Capital, near the Fortified Manor, First Floor grace.
o.pt: Encontrado em Leyndell, Royal Capital, perto da graça Fortified Manor, First Floor.

armas.d:
Battle hammer made to resemble flickering flames. Signature weapon of the Fire Monks, who hail from the Mountaintops of the Giants.

The unique strong attack rouses fiery combative spirit.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
A steel mace resembling a charming bouquet of roses. Each petal has a sharpened edge, leaving the roses perpetually colored with blood.

This weapon reflects White Mask Varré's manner of speech rather well, enticing in its splendor, but full of deadly consequence.

o.en: Found in Mohgwyn Palace (Siofra River), near the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint grace. Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Mohgwyn Palace (Siofra River), perto da graça Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint. Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Dropped by White Mask Varré in Mohgwyn Palace (Siofra River), near the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint grace. Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por White Mask Varré em Mohgwyn Palace (Siofra River), perto da graça Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt.

Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Mace shaped like a suspended metal droplet wielded by monks of the Eternal City.

Forged from liquid metal from a Silver Tear, it is thoroughly tempered until hardened.

o.en: On a corpse in Nokron (Siofra River), near the Night's Sacred Ground grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Nokron (Siofra River), perto da graça Night's Sacred Ground.

armas.d:
Bludgeon made of an enormous finger sheathed in several heavy rings. Thought to have been cut from an ancestor of the Fingercreeper.

Some life yet remains in this legacy of an ancient act of blasphemy, as evidenced by the barely perceptible warmth it still exudes.

o.en: Inside a chest in Gelmir Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau), near the Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Gelmir Hero's Grave (Altus Plateau), perto da graça Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy.

armas.d: Scepter in the form of a hand grasping a pearl. Signature weapon of Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing. The pearl stands for the world, the heavens, and an eye, representing the many forms of knowledge, never fully attainable. Even knowing that, the All-Knowing's hand grasps for it.

o.en: Reward for defeating Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing in Leyndell, Ashen Capital (Leyndell, Royal Capital).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing em Leyndell, Ashen Capital (Leyndell, Royal Capital).

armas.d:
Stone hammer made in the lands of the Numen, outside the Lands Between. The tool with which Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring and Radagon attempted to repair it.

The hammer partially broke upon shattering the Ring, becoming splintered with rune fragments.

o.en: Exchanged with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for the Elden Remembrance. Can be missed.
o.pt: Trocado com Finger Reader Enia na Roundtable Hold pela Elden Remembrance. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Weapon consisting of a bludgeoning head attached to a handle by a chain. The iron ball is spiked and induces blood loss.

Blows from this weapon cannot be parried. The charge attack whirls the iron ball around for increased force before striking.

o.en: Found in Leyndell, Ashen Capital (Leyndell, Royal Capital). Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Leyndell, Ashen Capital (Leyndell, Royal Capital). Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Inside a chest in Limgrave - Gatefront, Stormhill Evergaol, Groveside Cave Entrance, Limgrave Tunnels Entrance, near Gatefront Ruins.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Limgrave - Gatefront, Stormhill Evergaol, Groveside Cave Entrance, Limgrave Tunnels Entrance, perto de Gatefront Ruins.

o.en: Dropped by Brother Corhyn in Altus Plateau - Forest-Spanning Greatbridge, St. Trina's Hideaway, Sainted Hero's Grave Entrance. Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Brother Corhyn em Altus Plateau - Forest-Spanning Greatbridge, St. Trina's Hideaway, Sainted Hero's Grave Entrance. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
A flail with two additional bludgeoning heads.
Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

The large spikes make it highly effective at inducing blood loss, but also demand higher dexterity to wield.

o.en: Reward for defeating Night's Cavalry in Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne Approach North. Only at night.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Night's Cavalry em Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne Approach North. Só à noite.

armas.d:
A spiked iron tube attached by a chain wielded by Mad Pumpkin Heads.

Especially large for a flail, wielding it requires more strength than it does dexterity.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Three bludgeoning copper heads attached to a handle by chains. Signature weapon of Necromancer Garris, the heretical sage.

The heads were made to resemble those of his wife and two children.

o.en: Reward for defeating Necromancer Garris in Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Necromancer Garris em Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau).

armas.d:
Flail which deals magic damage, having been imbued with power by the remembrance of Astel.

Formed of the same many-colored star debris that comprised the form of the Naturalborn of the Void.

o.en: Exchanged with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for the Remembrance of the Naturalborn and 10,000 runes. Can be missed.
o.pt: Trocado com Finger Reader Enia na Roundtable Hold pela Remembrance of the Naturalborn e 10.000 runas. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
A thick, solid lump of wood.
Wielding this striking weapon requires no skill.

A simple, primitive weapon that requires only brute strength to swing about.

o.en: On a corpse in Weeping Peninsula - Bridge of Sacrifice, Forest Lookout Tower, Earthbore Cave Entrance, near Forlorn Hound Evergaol.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Weeping Peninsula - Bridge of Sacrifice, Forest Lookout Tower, Earthbore Cave Entrance, perto de Forlorn Hound Evergaol.

armas.d:
Large curved club of hard wood, shaped like a crescent moon.

Wielded by Albinaurics lacking the dexterity demanded by a curved sword, and who prefer the added weight and destructive force.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Huge bludgeon with sharp protrusions. An enlarged version of its smaller cousin.

Maintains all the advantages of smaller bludgeons, boasting few deficiencies while being very capable at breaking enemy guards and stances. A shrewd choice for simple slugging matches.

o.en: Inside a chest in Bellum Highway - Church of Inhibition, Southwest of Grand Lift of Dectus (Liurnia of the Lakes).
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Bellum Highway - Church of Inhibition, Southwest of Grand Lift of Dectus (Liurnia of the Lakes).

armas.d:
Large pickaxe designed to crack thick bedrock. Tool of sturdy miners.

Not originally designed as a weapon, but very adept at piercing armor.
"Little wretches, do you think your armor harder than stone?"

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Weapon made from an ordinary stone brick. Wielded by a laborer who lead a rebellion, and later become a champion himself.

Even among other bludgeons of its size, this weapon is especially weighty. The strength of a giant is required to wield it.

o.en: On a corpse in Stormveil Castle (Limgrave), near the Stormveil Cliffside grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Stormveil Castle (Limgrave), perto da graça Stormveil Cliffside.

armas.d:
Large iron great hammer designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.

Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Large iron great hammer designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot.

Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.

o.en: Dropped by Grave Warden Duelist in Consecrated Snowfield - Southwest Foggy Area (Mountaintops of the Giants).
o.pt: Deixado por Grave Warden Duelist em Consecrated Snowfield - Southwest Foggy Area (Mountaintops of the Giants).

armas.d:
Large bludgeon decorated with flowers and many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.

The striking end is a skull too large in size to be human.
Grants trace amounts of runes on landing attacks.

o.en: On a corpse in Altus Plateau - Windmill Heights, near Dominula, Windmill Village.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Altus Plateau - Windmill Heights, perto de Dominula, Windmill Village.

armas.d:
Huge bludgeon with three stars at the striking end. Though primarily a striking weapon, the stars' spikes cause blood loss.

A blood-stained star is an ill omen, a fact not lost upon those against whom this weapon is brought to bear. Landing attacks slightly restores HP.

o.en: Inside a chest in Altus Plateau - Road of Iniquity Side Path.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Altus Plateau - Road of Iniquity Side Path.

o.en: Reward for defeating Magnus the Beast Claw in Altus Plateau - Bower of Bounty, Writheblood Ruins. Can be missed.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Magnus the Beast Claw em Altus Plateau - Bower of Bounty, Writheblood Ruins. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Huge thick horn carved with tree ring-like markings adapted into a bludgeoning weapon. Wielded by ancestral follower warriors.

The ancient horn is imbued with the power of ancestral spirits. A small amount of HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Long golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt.

Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d: Candlestand used in worship of Birac, the most hallowed Monk Prelate of the Giants' Flame. Concerned over the lazy arrogance with which the monks treated the Flame, Birac severed his own head as a lesson to the others, intending it be used as a candlestand. His faith yet smolders from within the cranial vessel.

o.en: On a corpse in Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants), near the Zamor Ruins grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants), perto da graça Zamor Ruins.

armas.d:
Great hammer with a striking end modelled to resemble five beastly claws.

The black nails protruding from golden fur are said to represent Serosh, Lord of Beasts, who went on to become King Godfrey's Regent.

o.en: Dropped by Gurranq, Beast Clergyman in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow - Bestial Sanctum (Caelid). Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Gurranq, Beast Clergyman em Greyoll's Dragonbarrow - Bestial Sanctum (Caelid). Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Scepter in the shape of a serpent devouring the world. This weapon will one day become the very symbol of the Lord of Blasphemy.
One of the legendary armaments.

A vision of the future briefly seen by Rykard in his final moments before being devoured by the great serpent.

o.en: Reward for defeating Recusant Bernahl in Crumbling Farum Azula. Can be missed.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Recusant Bernahl em Crumbling Farum Azula. Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Dropped by Knight Bernahl in Stormhill - Warmaster's Shack, Stormgate (Limgrave), near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace. Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Knight Bernahl em Stormhill - Warmaster's Shack, Stormgate (Limgrave), perto da graça Dragon Temple Rooftop. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.

A weapon reserved for duelist champions, the charge attack is particularly ferocious.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat, now festering with scarlet rot.

Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.

o.en: Dropped by Grave Warden Duelist - group 1048575300 in Consecrated Snowfield - Ordina, Liturgical Town (Mountaintops of the Giants).
o.pt: Deixado por Grave Warden Duelist - group 1048575300 em Consecrated Snowfield - Ordina, Liturgical Town (Mountaintops of the Giants).

armas.d: A great halberd of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Wielded by the Guardian Golem.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d: A hammer made from a boulder, used in the War against the Giants. One of the heftiest weapons in the entire Lands Between. After the giants were quelled, and man turned against man in violence, this weapon was all but forgotten. Man has grown feeble in comparison to his forebears.

o.en: Inside a chest in Capital Outskirts - South of Outer Wall Phantom Tree (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Capital Outskirts - South of Outer Wall Phantom Tree (Altus Plateau).

armas.d:
Colossal hammer with the appearance of roiling flames. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. Its heft represents the weight of their guardianship.

The hammer's head is unusually substantial, and strong attacks will fling foes into the air.

o.en: Dropped by Fire Prelate in Mt. Gelmir - Fort Laiedd (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Deixado por Fire Prelate em Mt. Gelmir - Fort Laiedd (Altus Plateau).

armas.d: An enormous club of hard wood. Wildly hammering foes with this striking weapon requires no dexterity; only brute force. While it may seem sacrilegious, this weapon is said to be a withered branch of the Erdtree. Imbued with holy power, this weapon will never snap.

o.en: Reward for defeating Stonedigger Troll in Old Altus Tunnel (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Stonedigger Troll em Old Altus Tunnel (Altus Plateau).

armas.d:
Mining tool of stonedigger trolls used to crack bedrock.

Trolls are descended from the giants, and these were supposedly once used as ceremonial smithing tools. In the distant past, smithing was considered divine.

o.en: On a corpse in Old Altus Tunnel (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Old Altus Tunnel (Altus Plateau).

armas.d:
Weapon said to have been whittled from the claw of a great, ancient dragon, wielded by grotesque Tree Sentinels who yet serve the Erdtree.

The claw is enwreathed with lightning, and tears through the dragons' feeble descendants with ease.

o.en: Reward for defeating Draconic Tree Sentinel in Capital Outskirts - Capital Rampart, Auriza Side Tomb Entrance (Altus Plateau). Before Leyndell turns to ash.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Draconic Tree Sentinel em Capital Outskirts - Capital Rampart, Auriza Side Tomb Entrance (Altus Plateau). Antes de Leyndell virar cinzas.

armas.d:
Large stone staff embedded with glintstone. Wielded by Erdtree Burial Watchdogs who protect catacombs.

The Watchdogs, battered and broken over their lengthy tenure, rule the catacombs and are even said to command the imps.

o.en: On a corpse in Road's End Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes).
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Road's End Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes).

armas.d:
Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees.

The avatars, emerging in the wake of the Elden Ring's shattering, were determined to protect the withering Erdtree's offspring.

o.en: Reward for defeating Erdtree Avatar in Deeproot Depths (Siofra River).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Erdtree Avatar em Deeproot Depths (Siofra River).

armas.d:
Ceremonial staff depicting the Erdtree in its historic radiance. It festers with scarlet rot.

Wielded by the avatars who protect the Minor Erdtrees.

o.en: Reward for defeating Putrid Avatar in Miquella's Haligtree - Elphael.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Putrid Avatar em Miquella's Haligtree - Elphael.

armas.d:
Fanned golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt.

Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Great iron wheel lined with flesh-flaying blades. Device of torture used by Inquisitor Ghiza. As the wheel spins it causes severe pain and blood loss.

The design was adopted for use as the iconic weapon wielded by Iron Virgins.

o.en: Reward for defeating Inquisitor Ghiza in Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Inquisitor Ghiza em Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau).

armas.d:
Part of a Fallingstar Beast's jaw, hard and shining black, fashioned into a weapon.

With its sharp point, this colossal weapon can skewer foes.

o.en: Reward for defeating Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast in Mt. Gelmir - Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite, Road of Iniquity, Volcano Manor Entrance (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast em Mt. Gelmir - Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite, Road of Iniquity, Volcano Manor Entrance (Altus Plateau).

armas.d: Weapon of Godfrey, Elden Lord. It was broken in a battle fought as leader of the Tarnished during the Long March. This weapon is symbolic of Godfrey's vow to conduct himself as a lord, later becoming an emblem of the golden lineage. In the days of the past, a crown was warranted with strength.

o.en: Exchanged with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for the Remembrance of Hoarah Loux. Can be missed.
o.pt: Trocado com Finger Reader Enia na Roundtable Hold pela Remembrance of Hoarah Loux. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
An exceedingly plain spear of modest weight.

Simple to wield compared to many of its peers, its strong attack unleashes a series of successive piercing thrusts.

o.en: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 600 runes.
o.pt: Vendido pelas Twin Maiden Husks na Roundtable Hold por 600 runas.

armas.d:
Commonly used iron spear with no notable traits.
The blade is severely rusted.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Weapon comprised of a blade attached to a long haft.

A far-reaching piercing weapon, it can be wielded from behind the safety of a raised shield. Very effective against mounted foes.

o.en: Dropped by Patches in several places.
o.pt: Deixado por Patches em vários lugares.

armas.d:
Spear with a wide tip.

In addition to its thrusting attacks, this highly versatile weapon can be swung to sweep through foes.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
