o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
A longspear featuring an especially lengthy handle.

Specialized for use from long distances, it boasts the longest reach of any melee weapon. Incredibly useful even against foes on horseback, but hard to wield in cramped spaces.

o.en: On a corpse in Stormveil Castle (Limgrave), near the Liftside Chamber grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Stormveil Castle (Limgrave), perto da graça Liftside Chamber.

armas.d:
Weapon comprised of a spiked cylinder attached to a long pole. Capable of dealing strike damage when swung. The spikes induce blood loss.

Weapon of the Marionette Soldiers employed by sorcerers.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Weapon consisting of a three-pronged blade affixed to a long pole. The long central blade closely resembles a katana.

A weapon of the Land of Reeds, known for its ability to be wielded as a spear while still being capable of performing slashing attacks.

o.en: On a corpse in Gael Tunnel (Caelid), near Forsaken Ruins.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Gael Tunnel (Caelid), perto de Forsaken Ruins.

armas.d:
Harpoon with a tip made from a sharpened meteorite shard. Wielded by the claymen who infest dynastic remains.

The blade emits a faint light and deals magic damage.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Rake decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.

Crafted from human bone.
Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Torch fastened to a long pole. Lights up dark areas, but cannot be raised overhead.

Used by soldiers on watch, its attacks set foes aflame.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Instrument of torture used on nobles behind the curtain at the Volcano Manor of Mt. Gelmir.

Its numerous spikes pierce the flesh, then singe the wounds with flame. The smell of burnt blood induces despair in the victim. A candlestick conceived by a thorough mind.

o.en: Reward for defeating Abductor Virgin (Swinging Sickle) in Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Abductor Virgin (Swinging Sickle) em Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau).

armas.d: Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence. The inscrutable Crystalians have but one clear purpose; to safeguard their crystals unto the end. One theory posits that they yearn for the return of their creator who will carve for them new brethren.

o.en: Inside a chest in Sellia Hideaway (Caelid), near the Dragonbarrow Fork grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Sellia Hideaway (Caelid), perto da graça Dragonbarrow Fork.

armas.d:
Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human.
It festers with scarlet rot.

Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Spear of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

The winged golden blade deals holy damage. The diminutive shield is blessed with an incantation that wards off rot.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Ritual spear used by priests of old who were permitted to come among the Deathbirds.

The priests became guardians of the birds through the rite of Death, which also serves as an oath sworn to their distant resurrection.

o.en: Reward for defeating Death Rite Bird in Mountaintops of the Giants - West of Castle Sol; Consecrated Snowfield - North of Minor Erdtree.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Death Rite Bird em Mountaintops of the Giants - West of Castle Sol; Consecrated Snowfield - North of Minor Erdtree.

armas.d:
Spear whittled from the weapon wielded by Gransax.
One of the legendary armaments.

A great ancient dragon, Gransax once rained calamity upon the Royal Capital—the only time in historical record that Leyndell's walls have fallen. This marked the dawn of the war against the ancient dragons.

o.en: Found in Leyndell, Royal Capital, near the West Capital Rampart grace. Before Leyndell turns to ash.
o.pt: Encontrado em Leyndell, Royal Capital, perto da graça West Capital Rampart. Antes de Leyndell virar cinzas.

armas.d:
Considered a type of greatspear, this weapon has no blade, but instead features a long, conical body designed to pierce.

Though heavy and hard to wield, this weapon displays its worth in horseback combat whether mounted or even on foot.

o.en: On a corpse in Stormhill - North of Warmaster's Shack (Limgrave), near the Deathtouched Catacombs grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Stormhill - North of Warmaster's Shack (Limgrave), perto da graça Deathtouched Catacombs.

armas.d:
Golden spear with tree-like design. Wielded by knights employed as palace guards in the Royal Capital of Leyndell.
Deals holy damage.

Requiring superior dexterity to wield, this greatspear can perform consecutive thrust attacks despite its larger size.

o.en: Inside a chest in Liurnia - Liurnia Highway South Endpoint, Path to Stormhill (Liurnia of the Lakes), near the Godrick the Grafted grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Liurnia - Liurnia Highway South Endpoint, Path to Stormhill (Liurnia of the Lakes), perto da graça Godrick the Grafted.

armas.d: Weapon that serves as both greatsword and spear. Thought to have been used to hunt an immortal great serpent in the distant past, it manifests a long blade of light when facing such a creature. When their master's heroic aspirations degenerated into mere greed, his men searched for a weapon with which they might halt their lord.

o.en: Found in Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau), near the Audience Pathway grace.
o.pt: Encontrado em Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau), perto da graça Audience Pathway.

armas.d:
Siluria's Tree, weapon of one of the two honored as foremost among the Crucible Knights.

The primordial form of the Erdtree is close in nature to life itself, and this spear, modeled on its crucible, is imbued with ancient holy essence.

o.en: Reward for defeating Crucible Knight Siluria in Deeproot Depths (Siofra River).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Crucible Knight Siluria em Deeproot Depths (Siofra River).

armas.d:
War spear singed and blistered by fingers, used by Vyke, Knight of the Roundtable Hold.

Like Vyke himself, it has been tormented by the yellow flame of frenzy from within.

o.en: Reward for defeating Festering Fingerprint Vyke in Bellum Highway - Church of Inhibition, Southwest of Grand Lift of Dectus (Liurnia of the Lakes).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Festering Fingerprint Vyke em Bellum Highway - Church of Inhibition, Southwest of Grand Lift of Dectus (Liurnia of the Lakes).

armas.d:
Trident of Mohg, Lord of Blood. A sacred spear that will come to symbolize his dynasty.

As well as serving as a weapon, it is an instrument of communion with an outer god who bestows power upon accursed blood. The mother of truth desires a wound.

o.en: Exchanged with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for the Remembrance of the Blood Lord. Can be missed.
o.pt: Trocado com Finger Reader Enia na Roundtable Hold pela Remembrance of the Blood Lord. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
A long-handled polearm that combines the functions of both axe and spear.

Can be used to press a single enemy with continuous thrusting attacks, or swept at groups, taking advantage of its great reach and cleaving blade. A versatile weapon for any situation.

o.en: Sold by Nomadic Merchant (Limgrave - Summonwater Village Outskirts) for 1,200 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Nomadic Merchant (Limgrave - Summonwater Village Outskirts) por 1.200 runas.

armas.d:
A finely-crafted halberd intricately engraved with an ancient motif.
Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

o.en: Found in Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne. Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne. Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Reward for defeating Edgar the Revenger in Liurnia of the Lakes - Revenger's Shack. Can be missed.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Edgar the Revenger em Liurnia of the Lakes - Revenger's Shack. Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Dropped by Castellan Edgar in several places.
o.pt: Deixado por Castellan Edgar em vários lugares.

armas.d:
This polearm features a hard, sharpened beak-like spike attached to its head, designed to pierce armor.

Though designed mainly as a thrusting weapon, its long handle can be utilized to get around an enemy's guard with a sideward sweeping attack.

o.en: On a corpse in Liurnia of the Lakes - Liurnia Highway North.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Liurnia of the Lakes - Liurnia Highway North.

armas.d:
Weapon comprised of a sharp blade affixed to a long grip. It is in fact a sickle repurposed to be a tool of war.

This far-reaching weapon excels at slashing attacks.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
A hooked blade attached to a long handle. Wielded by the vulgar militia, its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.

The vulgar militia are the undecorated stewards of rancid, scorched battlefields that none dare approach, and forbidden domains better forgotten by the rest of the world.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d: A weapon comprised of a saw blade attached to a long grip. Brandished by the vulgar militia, its serrated edge is very effective at inflicting blood loss. The saw is said to also be used to cut up bodies to feed the militia, but there are no firsthand witnesses to confirm the dire rumor.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Weapon comprising a long handle and broad blade sharpened from the hard wood of old trees.

Wielded by guardians of the Minor Erdtrees, known as experts in the arts of combat. The power of this weapon scales greatly with dexterity.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyles.

Just like the wielder, the missing parts have been mended with corpse wax; a patchwork of champions.

o.en: Reward for defeating Gargoyle in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Gargoyle em Leyndell, Royal Capital.

armas.d:
Bronze halberd wielded by Valiant Gargoyles, mended with blackened corpse wax.
Deals holy damage.

Such is the mark of those who serve Maliketh, the Black Blade.

o.en: Reward for defeating Black Blade Kindred in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow - Bestial Sanctum (Caelid).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Black Blade Kindred em Greyoll's Dragonbarrow - Bestial Sanctum (Caelid).

armas.d:
A jet-black glaive with a blade as weighty as a bludgeon. Weapon of the Night's Cavalry who ride funeral steeds.

This glaive excels at weighty slash attacks that crash into foes, making it a powerful weapon even on horseback.

o.en: Reward for defeating Night's Cavalry in Bellum Highway - East Raya Lucaria Gate (Liurnia of the Lakes). Only at night.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Night's Cavalry em Bellum Highway - East Raya Lucaria Gate (Liurnia of the Lakes). Só à noite.

armas.d:
Glaive made from a hard, sharpened shell. Wielded by the pests who emerged from the Swamp of Aeonia.
Slightly increases non-physical damage negation.

Though men might recognize the keen intellect of the pests evidenced by this spear's uncanny design, it will never be understood by them.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Weapon wielded by young Albinaurics.

The blade is said to resemble a partial image of a ripple, and its attack power scales with one's arcane attribute.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Weighty halberd forged of gold. Wielded by the Order of Tree Sentinels, heavily equipped knights.
Deals holy damage.

A masterfully crafted weapon that lives up to its heft, but is difficult for one of mere human strength to wield.

o.en: Reward for defeating Tree Sentinel in Limgrave - Church of Elleh, Stranded Graveyard Exit.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Tree Sentinel em Limgrave - Church of Elleh, Stranded Graveyard Exit.

armas.d:
Halberd shaped like a dragon, enwreathed with both ice and lightning.

Alas, the Dragonkin Soldiers never attained immortality, and perished as decrepit, pale imitations of their skyborn kin.

o.en: Reward for defeating Dragonkin Soldier in Siofra River.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Dragonkin Soldier em Siofra River.

armas.d:
Intricately crafted silver war sickle wielded by Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree.

Originally given for service as a personal guard to Carian royalty, the weapon's blue glintstone has been replaced with unalloyed gold.

o.en: Reward for defeating Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree in Miquella's Haligtree.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree em Miquella's Haligtree.

armas.d:
A beaten red battle standard is furled around this time-worn halberd.

Even after his lord was fled, Commander O'Neil continued to brandish this flag in the devastation of the rot-eaten field of battle, the sole veteran who remembers this battle with pride.

o.en: Reward for defeating Commander O'Neil in Caelid - East Aeonia Swamp.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Commander O'Neil em Caelid - East Aeonia Swamp.

armas.d:
Large scythe featuring a long, slender blade. Designed to reap, this weapon is capable of rapidly inflicting blood loss while also slipping through an enemy's guard.

In the hands of a highly dexterous wielder it is capable of striking fear into the heart of any foe.

o.en: On a corpse in Cliffbottom Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes).
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Cliffbottom Catacombs (Liurnia of the Lakes).

armas.d:
Greatscythe comprised of a large blade affixed to a crooked stick. Weapon wielded by the aged grave keepers who tend the forgotten graveyards throughout the Lands Between.

This weapon is said to have served as a charm against evil spirits in times of old.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
War scythe of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

This was the weapon of commanders in Malenia's army, and the half-halo blade deals holy damage.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Sacred scythe resembling a pair of white wings. Deals holy damage.

According to pagan belief, white-winged maidens are said to be Death's gentle envoys.

o.en: Inside a chest in Weeping Peninsula - Tombsward Ruins.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Weeping Peninsula - Tombsward Ruins.

armas.d:
A leather whip. Not originally used for combat, but as an instrument of pain.

Though its supple attacks cannot be thwarted by parrying or even guarding, it is incapable of dealing critical hits.

o.en: On a corpse in Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne, near the Beside the Rampart Gaol grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne, perto da graça Beside the Rampart Gaol.

armas.d:
Hefty whip covered in crimson thorns. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. A device of fearsome religious encouragement, it is fashioned in the image of the briars of sin.

Very effective at inflicting blood loss.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
This weapon made of extremely thin, flexible blades of metal is wielded like a whip by Nightfolk warriors.

Though in essence a whip with a cutting edge, it can also be used as a spear to pierce foes.

o.en: On a corpse in Liurnia of the Lakes - Caria Manor, near the Main Caria Manor Gate grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Liurnia of the Lakes - Caria Manor, perto da graça Main Caria Manor Gate.

armas.d:
Metal whip formed of razor-sharp chain-link blades that have the appearance of flower petals. This work of art is handed down through the generations of the illustrious House Hoslow.
High dexterity is required to wield this weapon, but it excels at inflicting devastating blood loss.
"The tale of House Hoslow is told in blood."

o.en: Reward for defeating Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood in Mountaintops of the Giants - Shack of the Lofty; Consecrated Snowfield - Minor Erdtree, Albinauric Rise, Cave of the Forlorn Entrance. Can be missed.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood em Mountaintops of the Giants - Shack of the Lofty; Consecrated Snowfield - Minor Erdtree, Albinauric Rise, Cave of the Forlorn Entrance. Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Dropped by Potentate Diallos in Liurnia of the Lakes - Jarburg, Divine Tower of Liurnia Entrance. Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Potentate Diallos em Liurnia of the Lakes - Jarburg, Divine Tower of Liurnia Entrance. Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Dropped by Knight Diallos in Liurnia of the Lakes - Gate Town Southeast. Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Knight Diallos em Liurnia of the Lakes - Gate Town Southeast. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
This ritual implement is a three pronged candlestick with solid flames formed of the magma of Mt. Gelmir.

When wielded as a weapon, the flames become supple whips of lava.

o.en: Dropped by Patches in Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau). Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Patches em Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau). Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Hefty whip woven from the flame-red hair of a Fire Giant.

Every giant is red of hair, and Radagon was said to have despised his own red locks. Perhaps that was a curse of their kind.

o.en: Exchanged with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for the Remembrance of the Fire Giant and 10,000 runes. Can be missed.
o.pt: Trocado com Finger Reader Enia na Roundtable Hold pela Remembrance of the Fire Giant e 10.000 runas. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
A weapon built for striking with the fists, made of tough leather inlaid with iron rivets.

Fist weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.

o.en: Sold by Gatekeeper Gostoc (Stormveil Castle (Limgrave)) for 800 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Gatekeeper Gostoc (Stormveil Castle (Limgrave)) por 800 runas.

armas.d:
A caestus with the rivets replaced by blood loss-inducing spikes.

Fist weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.

o.en: Sold by Isolated Merchant (Greyoll's Dragonbarrow - Isolated Merchant's Shack (Caelid)) for 4,000 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Isolated Merchant (Greyoll's Dragonbarrow - Isolated Merchant's Shack (Caelid)) por 4.000 runas.

armas.d: Imported dagger design with a rather unique handle. The blade can be swung about as the extension of one's fist.

o.en: Inside a chest in Caelid - Fort Gael, Caelid Waypoint Ruins, Gaol Cave Entrance.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Caelid - Fort Gael, Caelid Waypoint Ruins, Gaol Cave Entrance.

armas.d:
Iron manifer of spherical shape. Big Boggart the blackguard's weapon of choice.

Not a weapon to be taken lightly, as its weighty blows shatter bones with ease.

o.en: Found in Capital Outskirts - South of Minor Erdtree (Altus Plateau). Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Capital Outskirts - South of Minor Erdtree (Altus Plateau). Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Dropped by Blackguard in Liurnia of the Lakes - Boilprawn Shack, Fallen Ruins of the Lake. Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Blackguard em Liurnia of the Lakes - Boilprawn Shack, Fallen Ruins of the Lake. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Spherical iron manifer covered in spikes which induce blood loss.

Used in brutal games of pugilism.

o.en: On a corpse in Leyndell, Royal Capital, near the Erdtree Sanctuary grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Leyndell, Royal Capital, perto da graça Erdtree Sanctuary.

armas.d:
Horrific weapon made of a hardened skeletal arm. Wielded by Ensha of the Royal Remains.

Fitted by placing one's hands into the fists' grips until they dig in.
"O clinging creature. A king relinquishes not the hand."

o.en: Reward for defeating Ensha of the Royal Remains in Roundtable Hold (Limgrave). Can be missed.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Ensha of the Royal Remains em Roundtable Hold (Limgrave). Pode ser perdido.

armas.d: Bladed prosthetic leg enwreathed with the power of lightning, instead attached to the fist. Commander Niall, veteran of Castle Sol, offered this prosthesis in exchange for the lives of defeated knights held prisoner. He went on to lead these men as an army of no nation.

o.en: Reward for defeating Commander Niall in Mountaintops of the Giants - South Castle Sol, Snow Valley Ruins Overlook.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Commander Niall em Mountaintops of the Giants - South Castle Sol, Snow Valley Ruins Overlook.

armas.d:
One of the weapons originating from the Two Fingers. A formless sequence of ciphers comprise its blade, and as such no shield can repel it. Deals holy damage.

The furtive inscription appears to hang in the air; the language of light spoken by the Two Fingers.

o.en: On a corpse in Roundtable Hold (Limgrave), near the Table of Lost Grace grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Roundtable Hold (Limgrave), perto da graça Table of Lost Grace.

armas.d:
The embodiment of the power that still remained in the dragon's head that was grafted to Godrick's left arm.

The wielder's arm will take the form of a small dragon, sprouting sharp dragon fangs at the fist.
This weapon cannot be two-handed.

o.en: Exchanged with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for the Remembrance of the Grafted and 2,000 runes. Can be missed.
o.pt: Trocado com Finger Reader Enia na Roundtable Hold pela Remembrance of the Grafted e 2.000 runas. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Weapon worn on the fist comprised of sharp parallel blades favored by those who lurk in the dark. Lacerations cause blood loss with great effect.

Claw weapons come in pairs, and two-handing this weapon will equip it to both hands.

o.en: On a corpse in Stormveil Castle (Limgrave), near the Rampart Tower grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Stormveil Castle (Limgrave), perto da graça Rampart Tower.

armas.d:
Large curved claws used by Bloodhound Knights.

The curve allows the weapon to slip through an enemy's guard.

o.en: Dropped by Bloodhound Knight in Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau), near the Prison Town Church grace.
o.pt: Deixado por Bloodhound Knight em Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau), perto da graça Prison Town Church.

armas.d:
One of the weapons designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.

The black fang protruding from the bronze snake head is coated in deadly poison.

o.en: On a corpse in Abandoned Cave (Caelid).
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Abandoned Cave (Caelid).

armas.d:
Claw comprised of two sharp, thin blades. Wielded by the assassins of ravenmount, this weapon allows them to imitate the attacks of Deathbirds.

Besides excelling at airborne attacks, its charge attack mimics the vicious swoop of a bird of prey.

o.en: Inside a chest in Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Sage's Cave (Altus Plateau).

armas.d:
Small bow made to fire arrows over great distances. Other than its ability to fire off arrows in rapid succession, it is also well-suited for use on horseback.

To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.

o.en: Sold by Nomadic Merchant (Limgrave - Coastal Cave Entrance) for 600 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Nomadic Merchant (Limgrave - Coastal Cave Entrance) por 600 runas.

armas.d:
Bow composited from a mix of materials.

Demands high attributes, and is tricky to wield, but is a fearsome tool when mastered.

o.en: Sold by Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia of the Lakes - Southeast Ravine, Lake at Caria Manor Entrance; Bellum Highway - Bellum Church) for 3,500 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia of the Lakes - Southeast Ravine, Lake at Caria Manor Entrance; Bellum Highway - Bellum Church) por 3.500 runas.

armas.d:
Shortbow of polished red wood. Fashioned by a master craftsman and wielded by pages.

A bow which requires dexterity rather than strength to master.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Shortbow wielded by Winged Misbegotten. Fine fur clings to it.

Designed to inflict additional damage by sacrificing range.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Bow fashioned from a minstrel's harp. Sonorous tones still resound when firing arrows.

Troubadours sing tales of champions, both in the honorable service of the Erdtree, and the one who spurns honor for blasphemy.

o.en: Found in Altus Plateau - Rampartside Path, Altus Tunnel Entrance.
o.pt: Encontrado em Altus Plateau - Rampartside Path, Altus Tunnel Entrance.

armas.d:
Longbow made to fire arrows over great distances. Compared to a shortbow, arrows fired reach further and deal more damage.

To use a bow, arrows must also be equipped.

o.en: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 1,200 runes.
o.pt: Vendido pelas Twin Maiden Husks na Roundtable Hold por 1.200 runas.

armas.d:
Longbow featuring delicate silverwork. Wielded by Albinauric wolfback archers.

This bow requires dexterity over strength to master.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Longbow carved from black wood to resemble a blade. One of the most difficult bows to master.

The blade-like body of the bow is light and cuts through the air. Though a longbow, it can be wielded similarly to a shortbow.

o.en: On a corpse in Leyndell, Royal Capital, near the Avenue Balcony grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Leyndell, Royal Capital, perto da graça Avenue Balcony.

armas.d:
Longbow which utilizes a series of pulleys and springs. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order fundamentalism.

Enhances precision while shooting, enabling arrows to fly much further distances.

o.en: On a corpse in Mt. Gelmir - First Mt. Gelmir Campsite, Corpse-Stench Shack; Altus Plateau - West of Shaded Castle.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Mt. Gelmir - First Mt. Gelmir Campsite, Corpse-Stench Shack; Altus Plateau - West of Shaded Castle.

armas.d:
Longbow made from animal horn. Wielded by the master hunters of the ancestral followers.

Imbues arrows fired with magic damage.
Reveals its true worth when used with magic-infused arrows.

o.en: On a corpse in Siofra River, near Hallowhorn Grounds.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Siofra River, perto de Hallowhorn Grounds.

armas.d:
Malformed bow in the shape of a pair of poisonous snakes. Imbues arrows with poison through pagan magic, revealing its true worth when used with poison-infused arrows.

Used by assassins known as the Formless Serpents.

o.en: On a corpse in Abandoned Cave (Caelid).
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Abandoned Cave (Caelid).

armas.d:
Longbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Arrow.

Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.

o.en: Inside a chest in Leyndell, Royal Capital, near the Erdtree Sanctuary grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Leyndell, Royal Capital, perto da graça Erdtree Sanctuary.

armas.d:
Enormous greatbow larger than any man. Can not be drawn with any ordinary level of strength, but the force of its shots is extraordinary.

A greatbow can only fire great arrows.

o.en: Inside a chest in Altus Plateau - East Windmill Village, Highway Lookout Tower.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Altus Plateau - East Windmill Village, Highway Lookout Tower.

armas.d:
Greatbow of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Weapon of the Guardian Golem.

Extremely heavy, this greatbow requires enormous strength just to draw, suggesting it was not designed for human use.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Greatbow featuring Erdtree styling. In times of old, when faith and battle went hand in hand, this weapon was created in tandem with the Golden Great Arrow.

Scales all arrow damage with faith, revealing its true worth when used with holy-infused arrows.

o.en: Reward for defeating Merciless Chariot in Stranded Graveyard (Limgrave).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Merciless Chariot em Stranded Graveyard (Limgrave).

armas.d:
Greatbow of black iron wielded by General Radahn. Decorated with a lion mane motif.

Imbued with gravitational power of the Starscourge, when used along with Radahn's Spear, it becomes a true weapon of a champion.

o.en: Exchanged with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for the Remembrance of the Starscourge. Can be missed.
o.pt: Trocado com Finger Reader Enia na Roundtable Hold pela Remembrance of the Starscourge. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
A crossbow of simple make, usable by anyone, but lacking in both power and accuracy.

Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Ranged weapon made from a bow fixed to a stock. Deals good damage and is simple to use, but requires reloading after firing.

Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

o.en: Sold by Nomadic Merchant (Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne Rampart, Ailing Village Outskirts) for 1,500 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Nomadic Merchant (Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne Rampart, Ailing Village Outskirts) por 1.500 runas.

armas.d:
Heavy crossbow with iron limbs, increasing damage dealt.

Commonly employed in the Shattering.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Large crossbow made from composite materials. One of the largest of all bolt-firing devices.

Its limbs are more pliable than metallic ones, allowing bolts fired from this weapon to pierce even helms forged of steel.

o.en: On a corpse in Stormveil Castle (Limgrave), near the Limgrave Tower Bridge grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Stormveil Castle (Limgrave), perto da graça Limgrave Tower Bridge.

armas.d:
Black crossbow featuring a long stock. Used for sniping, it has a very long range.

Weapon of Crepus, who served the Two Fingers from the shadows of the Roundtable as the head confessor.

o.en: Inside a chest in Roundtable Hold (Limgrave), near the Table of Lost Grace grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Roundtable Hold (Limgrave), perto da graça Table of Lost Grace.

armas.d:
Crossbow made with pulleys and power springs. The complex mechanism, which required advanced mathematical and mechanical understanding to craft, was likely made by a certain genius who learned Golden Order fundamentalism.
One touch fires a volley of bolts. Be warned; large stores of bolts can be quickly spent.

o.en: On a corpse in Mt. Gelmir - Craftsman's Shack, Hermit's Shack (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Mt. Gelmir - Craftsman's Shack, Hermit's Shack (Altus Plateau).

armas.d: One-of-a-kind enchanted crossbow of exquisitely detailed craftsmanship. Made to celebrate the matrimonial union, and reconciliation, between the houses of the Erdtree and the Full Moon, Leyndell and Raya Lucaria. The two rings dance when reloading the weapon. Reveals true worth when used with holy-infused bolts.

o.en: Inside a chest in Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes), near the Church of the Cuckoo grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes), perto da graça Church of the Cuckoo.

armas.d:
An unconventional ballistic device modelled on a weapon used to besiege castles. Only capable of firing greatbolts.

Perfect for reckless acts such as storming a castle or facing an entire army alone.

o.en: Inside a chest in Weeping Peninsula - Bridge of Sacrifice, Forest Lookout Tower, Earthbore Cave Entrance.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Weeping Peninsula - Bridge of Sacrifice, Forest Lookout Tower, Earthbore Cave Entrance.

armas.d:
Jar cannon which uses explosives to fire greatbolts. Deals great damage but is slow to reload.

Experimental firearm brought to the assault on Volcano Manor, where it was discovered that no one knew how to use it.

o.en: Reward for defeating Demi-Human Queen Margot in Volcano Cave (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Demi-Human Queen Margot em Volcano Cave (Altus Plateau).

armas.d:
Staff of the astrologers. A glintstone is embedded in the tip, enabling it to be used as a catalyst for sorceries.

Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

o.en: Sold by Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia of the Lakes - Laskyar Ruins, Malefactor's Evergaol) for 800 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia of the Lakes - Laskyar Ruins, Malefactor's Evergaol) por 800 runas.

armas.d:
Staff with a glintstone embedded at the tip. A catalyst for casting sorceries.

Sorceries must be memorized first at a site of lost grace, and a staff must be equipped to cast them.

o.en: Dropped by Wandering Noble in Limgrave - Waypoint Ruins, near the Waypoint Ruins Cellar grace.
o.pt: Deixado por Wandering Noble em Limgrave - Waypoint Ruins, perto da graça Waypoint Ruins Cellar.

armas.d:
Staff of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, embedded with a turquoise glintstone.

Only a recognized sorcerer is permitted to wield this staff.

o.en: Found in Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes), near the Schoolhouse Classroom grace. Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes), perto da graça Schoolhouse Classroom. Pode ser perdido.

o.en: Dropped by Sorcerer Thops in Liurnia of the Lakes - Church of Irith, near the Schoolhouse Classroom grace. Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Sorcerer Thops em Liurnia of the Lakes - Church of Irith, perto da graça Schoolhouse Classroom. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Staff of a sorcerer-miner who extracts glintstone from crystal tunnels. The staff itself is a tool used to mine, and the ferrule is also embedded with a glintstone.

Boosts the power of Stonedigger sorceries.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Glintstone staff styled as a scepter. A gift once given to the demi-humans to foster peace, it can be wielded even by those of low intelligence.

Sneered at by fools in the academy.

o.en: Reward for defeating Demi-Human Queen in Weeping Peninsula - Church of Pilgrimage, Demi-Human Forest Ruins.
o.pt: Recompensa por derrotar Demi-Human Queen em Weeping Peninsula - Church of Pilgrimage, Demi-Human Forest Ruins.

armas.d:
Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Azur. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom of stone may wield it.

Reduces casting time of all sorceries, but consumes additional FP.

o.en: Found in Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes), near the Church of the Cuckoo grace.
o.pt: Encontrado em Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes), perto da graça Church of the Cuckoo.

armas.d:
Staff of the primeval glintstone sorcerer Lusat. Only those who have glimpsed what lies beyond the wisdom of stone may wield it.

Enhances power of all sorceries, but consumes additional FP.

o.en: Inside a chest in Caelid - West Sellia, Sellia Crystal Tunnel Entrance, near the Chair-Crypt of Sellia grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Caelid - West Sellia, Sellia Crystal Tunnel Entrance, perto da graça Chair-Crypt of Sellia.

armas.d:
Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff.

Given to sorcerers that they might enact the role of knight. Enhances Carian sword sorceries.

o.en: Found in Divine Tower of Liurnia (Liurnia of the Lakes), near Carian Study Hall.
o.pt: Encontrado em Divine Tower of Liurnia (Liurnia of the Lakes), perto de Carian Study Hall.

armas.d:
Staff embedded with a blue glintstone. One of two types of Carian staff.

Gifted to enchanted knights, it enhances Glintblade sorceries.

o.en: On a corpse in Liurnia of the Lakes - Highway Lookout Tower.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Liurnia of the Lakes - Highway Lookout Tower.

armas.d:
Magic scepter of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. The glintstone is known as a Carian Blue, enhancing full moon sorceries.

Only those of the highest intelligence may wield this, the finest of all glintstone staves.

o.en: Exchanged with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold for the Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen. Can be missed.
o.pt: Trocado com Finger Reader Enia na Roundtable Hold pela Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen. Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Short staff with a blue glintstone embedded. Wielded by the Albinaurics of old.

The Albinaurics harbor a secret; they cast sorcery using their innate arcaneness.

o.en: On a corpse in Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau), near the Guest Hall grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau), perto da graça Guest Hall.

armas.d:
Staff missing its glintstone. Wielded by sorcerers who believe that discovery comes through acts of asceticism.

This staff only distinguishes itself when casting invisibility sorceries, but that is reason enough for some to wield it.

o.en: On a corpse in Caelid - West Sellia, Sellia Crystal Tunnel Entrance, near the Sellia Under-Stair grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Caelid - West Sellia, Sellia Crystal Tunnel Entrance, perto da graça Sellia Under-Stair.

armas.d:
Staff with a forked tip, embedded with red glintstones. Enhances lava sorceries.

The Man-Serpents of Mt. Gelmir draw from faith in addition to intelligence to enhance the potency of their sorcery.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. Enhances Crystalian sorceries.

The Crystalian's faint cogitation is known as the "wisdom of stone." This staff can only be wielded by those of intellect high enough to grasp such wisdom.

o.en: Inside a chest in Academy Crystal Cave (Liurnia of the Lakes).
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Academy Crystal Cave (Liurnia of the Lakes).

armas.d:
Staff fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot.

Enhances Crystalian sorceries.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Staff embedded with a dark purple glintstone, said to be the fragment of a meteorite. Boasts high sorcery scaling and boosts gravity sorceries as well.

However, this staff cannot be strengthened in any way.

o.en: On a corpse in Caelid - West Aeonia Swamp, near Street of Sages Ruins.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Caelid - West Aeonia Swamp, perto de Street of Sages Ruins.

armas.d:
A heretical staff fashioned from a smoldering, withered sapling that turns the blood of sacrifices pierced by it into glintstone. Similar to hex magic.

Sorceries are scaled with faith rather than intelligence when wielding this staff which enhances thorn sorceries in particular.

o.en: Usually dropped by enemies that use it.
o.pt: Geralmente deixado por inimigos que usam esta arma.

armas.d:
Staff embedded with sullied amber, said to be a very part of the Prince of Death. Enhances death sorceries.

One of the staves deemed heretical by the academy for its ability to allow sorceries to be augmented through faith in addition to intelligence.

o.en: On a corpse in Deeproot Depths (Siofra River), near The Nameless Eternal City grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Deeproot Depths (Siofra River), perto da graça The Nameless Eternal City.

armas.d:
A sacred seal bestowed by a Finger Maiden which serves as a catalyst for casting sacred incantations.

Incantations must be memorized first at a site of grace, and a sacred seal must be equipped to cast them.

o.en: Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold for 800 runes.
o.pt: Vendido pelas Twin Maiden Husks na Roundtable Hold por 800 runas.

armas.d:
A formless sacred seal decorated with an Erdtree crest, once the focus of religion in the Lands Between.

Even though the Elden Ring is shattered, and the Erdtree has dulled from its former radiance, earnest faith continues to hold the answers.

o.en: On a corpse in Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau), near the Prison Town Church grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Volcano Manor (Altus Plateau), perto da graça Prison Town Church.

armas.d:
A formless sacred seal depicting the ceremonial observation of Order. Enhances Golden Order Fundamentalist incantations.

Fundamentalism is scholarship in all but name. Scales incantations using both intelligence and faith.

o.en: On a corpse in Capital Outskirts - Minor Erdtree Church, Sealed Tunnel Entrance (Altus Plateau).
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Capital Outskirts - Minor Erdtree Church, Sealed Tunnel Entrance (Altus Plateau).

armas.d:
Sacred seal made from Gravel Stone thought to be an ancient dragon scale. Enhances Dragon Cult incantations of the Royal Capital.

The worship of the ancient dragons does not conflict with belief in the Erdtree. After all, this seal, and lightning itself, are both imbued with gold.

o.en: Dropped by Leyndell Knight in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
o.pt: Deixado por Leyndell Knight em Leyndell, Royal Capital.

armas.d:
Sacred seal depicting the one-eyed god of the Fire Giants, adorned with braids of red hair.

Sacred seal wielded by Fire Monks and Prelates, this catalyst enhances Giants' Flame incantations.

o.en: Found in Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants).
o.pt: Encontrado em Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave (Mountaintops of the Giants).

armas.d:
Sacred seal of the Godskin Apostles, inlaid with obsidian.

Said to represent the manipulation of black flame, this catalyst enhances godslayer incantations.

o.en: Inside a chest in Stormveil Castle (Limgrave), near the Rampart Tower grace.
o.pt: Dentro de um baú em Stormveil Castle (Limgrave), perto da graça Rampart Tower.

armas.d:
Sacred seal granted by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. A rare trinket which allows incantations to be scaled with strength.

The claw mark represents Gurranq's wrath. Enhances bestial incantations learned from Gurranq.

o.en: Dropped by Gurranq, Beast Clergyman in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow - Bestial Sanctum (Caelid). Can be missed.
o.pt: Deixado por Gurranq, Beast Clergyman em Greyoll's Dragonbarrow - Bestial Sanctum (Caelid). Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Formless sacred seal bestowed by the maiden of the Three Fingers. Enhances incantations of the frenzied flame.

This seal is the mark of the Lord of Frenzied Flame. Scales incantations using strength, dexterity, intelligence, and faith all together.

o.en: Found in Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital). Can be missed.
o.pt: Encontrado em Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital). Pode ser perdido.

armas.d:
Formless drakeblood seal with a dragon communion crest. Enhances Dragon Communion incantations.

The sacrificial devouring of the heart gives power.
Indeed, Dragon Communion is too primal in nature for the term "incantation" to be appropriate.
This seal scales incantations with one's arcane attribute.

o.en: Dropped by Banished Knight in Stranded Graveyard (Limgrave), near Fringefolk Hero's Grave.
o.pt: Deixado por Banished Knight em Stranded Graveyard (Limgrave), perto de Fringefolk Hero's Grave.

armas.d:
This torch's tip is wrapped in oil-soaked rags and set on fire.
The flame can illuminate dark locales, or be used to attack enemies.

Can be raised up when equipped in the left hand,
illuminating more of the surrounding area.

o.en: Sold by Merchant Kalé (Limgrave - Church of Elleh, Stranded Graveyard Exit) for 200 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Merchant Kalé (Limgrave - Church of Elleh, Stranded Graveyard Exit) por 200 runas.

armas.d:
A torch which burns oil infused with a special incense. The aroma pacifies wild beasts.

Torches such as these were used to keep unwelcome beasts away from treasure troves hidden in caves.

o.en: Sold by Isolated Merchant (Greyoll's Dragonbarrow - Isolated Merchant's Shack (Caelid)) for 1,200 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Isolated Merchant (Greyoll's Dragonbarrow - Isolated Merchant's Shack (Caelid)) por 1.200 runas.

armas.d:
Torch wound with metal wire. The flame can illuminate dark locales, or be used to attack enemies.

Heavier than a normal torch, but the heated filament boosts fire damage dealt.

o.en: On a corpse in Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne, near the Behind the Castle grace.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Weeping Peninsula - Castle Morne, perto da graça Behind the Castle.

armas.d: Torch given to protectors of the Erdtree. Its flames are bestowed with a special incantation which allows the bearer to see assassins cloaked in veils. Furnished on behalf of the Erdtree and the Grace-Given Lord such that a Night of Black Knives will never come again.

o.en: Sold by Hermit Merchant (Capital Outskirts - Northeast Outer Wall Battleground, Hermit Merchant's Shack (Altus Plateau)) for 7,000 runes.
o.pt: Vendido por Hermit Merchant (Capital Outskirts - Northeast Outer Wall Battleground, Hermit Merchant's Shack (Altus Plateau)) por 7.000 runas.

armas.d: Metal torch that burns with cold ghostflame. Tool of the Fallen Hawks who prowl the underground rivers. When the band's last embers were used up in their long search, they began to burn the bones of their fellows, acquiring the cold ghostflame, but sealing their fate as dwellers of the underground for all eternity.

o.en: On a corpse in Nokron Start (Siofra River), near Minor Erdtree.
o.pt: Em um cadáver em Nokron Start (Siofra River), perto de Minor Erdtree.

armas.d:

The light-purple flame induces sleep.
